candidates.source_name: ZBS – Združenje bank Slovenije (Bank Association of Slovenia) – members page (Članice)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of the entire Slovenian demand side for banking technology: banks, savings banks (hranilnice) and leasing companies. Logos observed include NLB, Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP, Sparkasse, Addiko, BKS, Gorenjska banka, DBS, Delavska hranilnica, LON, SID, SKB and 10+ leasing firms. This is the master actor list every vendor/partnership finding in workstream A6 must be joined against.
candidates.legal_status: public corporate information; copyrighted page layout
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly HTML fetch + parse of member logo/link blocks; diff against previous snapshot to detect entries/exits (mergers are frequent in SI banking).
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search on association name, then direct fetch
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije člani banke ZBS

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost (committees, sections, working bodies)
candidates.why_relevant: Committee/section structure (e.g. payments, IT/security, cards) names the bank staff and working bodies that vendors sell into and co-present with; committee membership reveals which institutions drive shared-infrastructure decisions (payments, instant payments, anti-fraud).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual fetch; extract committee names + member institutions into actor graph.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ZBS members page fetch
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije člani banke ZBS

candidates.source_name: ZBS – news / press releases (governing-body appointments, sector initiatives)
candidates.why_relevant: Association news items name supervisory-board members per bank and announce sector-wide projects (payments schemes, digital identity, education centre). Useful for dating leadership change and for spotting collective procurement/infrastructure initiatives that vendors bid into.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of news index; keyword filter on plačila, kartice, kibernetska varnost, digitalizacija.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije člani banke ZBS

candidates.source_name: GZS ZIT – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije: official member list PDF (Seznam članov)
candidates.why_relevant: The single highest-yield artefact for this cell: a maintained, dated (July 2026) roster of Slovenian ICT companies inside the national chamber. It enumerates integrators, software houses and telco/IT suppliers — including small firms invisible to media — that form the candidate pool of banking-sector vendors and Printec competitors/partners.
candidates.access_status: open PDF link published on ZIT membership page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the Članstvo page each quarter, resolve the current dated PDF link (filename carries month/year), PDF-to-text, normalise company names, match against AJPES/company register for NACE + revenue.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search then fetch of ZIT Članstvo page which links the PDF
queries_used: ZIT Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije GZS seznam članov

candidates.source_name: GZS ZIT – Sekcije / Projekti (sections and projects)
candidates.why_relevant: ZIT organises vendors into thematic sections and working groups (cybersecurity, digital skills, e-business). Section leadership is drawn from vendor management, so these pages map which firms claim authority in which technology area — a cheap proxy for competitor positioning.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl section subtree; extract section names and named company representatives.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ZIT Članstvo fetch
queries_used: ZIT Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije GZS seznam članov

candidates.source_name: GZS ZIT – Upravni odbor (management board)
candidates.why_relevant: Board seats are held by executives of the leading Slovenian ICT vendors; the roster is a ranked-by-influence shortlist of the firms that shape ICT policy and are best placed to win bank contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual fetch; person+company extraction into actor graph.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl search

candidates.why_relevant: GZS offers sector-filtered company lists with contact data — the umbrella route to member companies across all its branch associations, not just ZIT. Search result text indicates the detailed contact data is reserved for GZS members, so this is a paywalled/membership-gated pointer to be scoped before relying on it.

candidates.why_relevant: Adjacent GZS branch chamber covering electronics/electrical industry — the home of hardware manufacturers and device suppliers (terminals, kiosks, self-service, components) that overlap the payments hardware value chain. candidates.why_relevant: 400+ member companies including the Slovenian subsidiaries of US and international technology vendors and the large banks. Cross-sector directory that identifies which multinational payments/IT vendors maintain a Slovenian commercial presence — precisely the competitor set that does not appear in local ICT rosters.
candidates.legal_status: public directory; respect robots.txt and rate limits

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian FINTECH industry association with a public member directory was found. Searches in Slovenian for 'fintech združenje Slovenija' returned only blockchain/crypto bodies (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA, Bitcoin društvo Slovenije), not a payments/fintech trade association comparable to e.g. Fintech Austria.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian fintech interests appear to be represented indirectly, via ZBS (bank side), ZIT/GZS (ICT side) and blockchain alliances, rather than by a standalone fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no single membership list that enumerates Slovenian fintech vendors; A6 vendor discovery must therefore triangulate ZIT + AmCham + DSI sponsors + blockchain alliances instead of relying on one roster.

negative_findings.description: ZBS publishes member logos but no public list of associate/affiliate or supplier members, and no public register of vendors participating in its committees or its education centre (Izobraževalni center) programmes was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: ZBS members page enumerates banks, savings banks and leasing companies only; the vendor-facing side of ZBS activity is not published as a directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank–vendor working relationships visible through association committees must be recovered from event programmes and news items rather than a roster, raising collection cost.

negative_findings.description: GZS's company-data service indicates that basic company contact information is available only to GZS members; the AHK Slovenija online member directory may likewise be partly gated (not confirmed in this pass).
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of the largest chamber directories in scope may be membership-gated rather than openly crawlable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget or partnership decisions may be needed to obtain full chamber rosters; otherwise coverage skews toward associations with open directories (AmCham, BSCC, ZIT PDF).

negative_findings.description: The ZIT member-list PDF URL (04_Seznam članov_JULIJ 2026.pdf) was reported by a fetch of the ZIT Članstvo page but was not itself opened; its filename is date-stamped and will change when the roster is refreshed.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL recorded as a candidate with a note that the dated filename must be re-resolved from the parent page on each run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hard-coding the dated PDF URL into a collector will silently break; the collector must resolve the link from the Članstvo page each time.

negative_findings.description: Foreign bilateral chambers beyond AmCham, AHK and BSCC (e.g. French, Italian, Nordic, Dutch chambers in Slovenia) were not searched in this pass due to cell time budget.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of bilateral chambers is partial.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Italian- and Austrian-origin vendors are commercially relevant to Slovenian banking given ownership structures (Intesa Sanpaolo, Sparkasse, BKS, Addiko); their chambers may hold directories not covered here.

coverage_gaps.description: Bilateral chambers of the ownership countries of Slovenian banks — Italian (Intesa Sanpaolo), Austrian (Sparkasse, BKS, Addiko), Hungarian (OTP), French (SKB/OTP legacy) — were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on Italian, Austrian, French, Nordic and Dutch chambers of commerce in Slovenia, searching in sl/it/de, and capture their member directories and event/committee pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Association EVENT and CONFERENCE programme archives (ZBS Izobraževalni center, GZS/ZIT events, AmCham committee events) were identified conceptually but not systematically harvested; these are where bank–vendor working relationships and case studies are exposed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a dedicated event-programme collector across zbs-giz.si, gzs.si/zit, amcham.si and dsi-konferenca.si microsites; extract speaker name + employer pairs into a bank–vendor co-appearance graph.

coverage_gaps.description: No credible Slovenian-language term for a domestic 'fintech association' surfaced; the local vocabulary in this space is dominated by 'veriga blokov / blockchain' and 'digitalizacija', not 'fintech'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the glossary with 'plačilne storitve', 'plačilna institucija', 'ponudnik plačilnih storitev (PSP)', 'elektronski denar' and re-run association searches on those terms, including against the Bank of Slovenia register of payment institutions.

coverage_gaps.description: Access status (open vs. member-gated) is unconfirmed for AHK Slovenija's member directory and for the AmCham full member list beyond the landing page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deterministic liveness/access pass should classify each directory URL as open, partially gated, or login-required, and record pagination structure for the crawlable ones.

coverage_gaps.description: Craft/SME chamber (OZS – Obrtno-podjetniška zbornica Slovenije), startup ecosystem bodies (Tehnološki park Ljubljana, Start:up Slovenija) and clusters outside ICT were not searched, although they list small software suppliers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Follow-up pass on OZS sekcija za informacijsko dejavnost, Tehnološki park Ljubljana tenant list, and Start:up Slovenija company database.

brief: Slovenia's association layer splits cleanly into a demand-side pointer and several supply-side pointers: ZBS (zbs-giz.si) publishes the definitive roster of banks, savings banks and leasing companies, while GZS's ICT association ZIT publishes a dated, downloadable member-list PDF that is the single richest enumeration of Slovenian ICT vendors, complemented by its sections, board and position-paper pages. Cross-sector chambers — AmCham Slovenia (400+ members, open list), AHK Slovenija (~280 members) and BSCC (~100 members plus published councils) — surface the international vendors that consider Slovenia a market but never appear in local ICT rosters. A second tier of innovation-policy bodies (Slovenska digitalna koalicija, DIH Slovenije/EDIH DIGI-SI, IKT horizontalna mreža SRIP PMiS) and the DSI conference sponsor tiers provide dated, ranked evidence of vendor commitment and bank–vendor co-appearance. The main structural gaps are the absence of any dedicated Slovenian fintech association, probable membership gating on GZS and AHK company data, and the unharvested event/committee programmes where actual bank–vendor working relationships are exposed.
